#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int readInt() {
    int result = 0;
    bool negative = false;
    int ch;
    bool started = false;
    while ((ch = getchar()) != EOF) {
        if (ch == '-') {
            started = true;
            negative = true;
            continue;
        }
        if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
            started = true;
            result = result * 10 + ch - '0';
        } else if (started) {
            break;
        }
    }
    return negative ? -result : result;
}

struct Test {
    int r, c;
    vector<char> sequence;
    long long C[64][64];
    long long bestDist;
    int countA[64], countB[64];
    map<long long, long long> memo;

    void dfs(long long x, long long y, int v1, int v2) {
        long long dist = llabs(x - y);
        if (bestDist <= 1 || dist - C[v1][r] * C[v2][r] >= bestDist) return;
        if (v1 == 0 && v2 == 0) {
            if (dist < bestDist) bestDist = dist;
            return;
        }
        if (v1 > 0) {
            long long deltaX = C[v1][r] - C[v1 - 1][r], s2 = C[v2][r];
            dfs(x, y + deltaX * s2, v1 - 1, v2);
        }
        if (v2 > 0) {
            long long s1 = C[v1][r], deltaY = C[v2][r] - C[v2 - 1][r];
            dfs(x + s1 * deltaY, y, v1, v2 - 1);
        }
    }

    long long solve(long long x, long long y, int v1, int v2) {
        long long key = x * 10000LL + v1 * 100 + v2;
        auto it = memo.find(key);
        if (it != memo.end()) return it->second;
        long long result = 0;
        long long d = llabs(x - y);
        if (d - C[v1][r] * C[v2][r] > bestDist) {
            memo[key] = result;
            return result;
        }
        if (v1 == 0 && v2 == 0) return 1;
        char c = sequence[v1 + v2 - 1];
        if (v1 > 0 && c != 'B') {
            long long c1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1 - 1][r], s2 = C[v2][r];
            result += solve(x, y + c1 * s2, v1 - 1, v2);
        }
        if (v2 > 0 && c != 'A') {
            long long s1 = C[v1][r], c2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2 - 1][r];
            result += solve(x + s1 * c2, y, v1, v2 - 1);
        }
        memo[key] = result;
        return result;
    }

    void run() {
        r = readInt(); c = readInt(); getchar();
        sequence.resize(2 * (r + c));
        for (int i = 0; i < 2 * (r + c); i++) {
            sequence[i] = getchar();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= 2 * (r + c); i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= 2 * (r + c); j++) {
                if (j == 0) C[i][j] = 1;
                else if (i == 0) C[i][j] = 0;
                else C[i][j] = C[i - 1][j - 1] + C[i - 1][j];
            }
        }
        int v1 = r + c, v2 = r + c;
        long long x = 0, y = 0;
        while (v1 >= r && v2 >= r) {
            if (x > y) {
                long long c1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1 - 1][r], s2 = C[v2][r];
                y += c1 * s2;
                v1--;
            } else {
                long long s1 = C[v1][r], c2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2 - 1][r];
                x += s1 * c2;
                v2--;
            }
        }
        bestDist = llabs(x - y);
        dfs(0, 0, r + c, r + c);
        for (int i = 0; i < 2 * (r + c); i++) {
            countA[i + 1] = countA[i] + (sequence[i] == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
            countB[i + 1] = countB[i] + (sequence[i] == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
        }
        long long answer = solve(0, 0, r + c, r + c);
        cout << answer << "\n";
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    Test t;
    t.run();
    return 0;
}
